report.explanation: All four services report identical healthy metrics (error_rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts, zero db pool waiters, flat memory). No telemetry substantiates any public cause; the alert is not corroborated by current read-only evidence. Handing off for broader telemetry rather than asserting an unsupported root cause.
